title: Sensex soars 2,009 points as oil slides; Nifty's sixth straight gain takes it to 24,537
short: Sensex soars 2,009 pts as oil slides; Nifty at 24,537
dek: The benchmarks had their biggest one-day rally in seven months as Brent crude tumbled and foreign investors kept buying. Banks, finance companies and carmakers led.
card: Nifty +576 at 24,536.60, Sensex +2,008.61 at 79,310.01. Auto +4.14%, Bajaj Finance +7.65%; Apollo Hospitals −2.66%.
